caption: The drawing depicts a stylized bird perched on a large floral stem. The bird has a yellow head and body with red and blue accents, including a blue patch on its chest and a red tail with yellow and red feather detailing. Its eye is drawn as a circle with a blue center, and it has three blue feathers on top of its head. The beak is blue. The bird stands on a red, symmetrical branch extending from a main vertical stem. Below the bird, there are large, blue, symmetrical flowers with yellow stems and red accents, each with four petals. The central stem is decorated with yellow and red stylized leaves, symmetrically arranged. At the base of the stem, two blue and yellow curved lines fan outward. The entire image uses a limited palette of red, yellow, blue, and green on a beige background. Text at the bottom reads: "FROM A SGRAFFITO PLATE MADE BY GEORG HUBENER 1789".
title: Plate 4: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
